Isolated journal bearing FBD and axial view. The 6-lbf shaft load is balanced by the housing reaction.

Dimensioned frame concept derived from the analysis: front and top views, four supports, nominal 5-in shaft spacing, and 1.500-in bearing spans.
Bearing-post FBD for the cantilever model, showing the 6-lbf load at a 1.750-in height and the fixed-foot reactions.
